content.title: After the warning ends
content.summary: A quick recall check on what to do before anyone leaves the shelter room.

checkin.prompt: The tornado warning has ended, and you don't know yet whether there is damage nearby. What do you do first?

choices.label: Go outside right away to look around
Check official updates before you leave the room
Move any fallen power lines out of the way

checkin.remember: Check official updates before you leave the room, and stay clear of fallen power lines.
checkin.fullerExplanation: Ready.gov says to pay attention to EAS, NOAA Weather Radio, and local authorities for updated information. Check those before you leave the room, and stay clear of fallen power lines.
